compared: No public item drawn from stacks-project:more-algebra.tex states this characterization. The 57 public items of that chapter (problem ids 304-430, 1744-1746, 1799) were resolved to their source labels through the project's canonical tag list, and none of them carries the label lemma-pseudo-coherent (tag 064U) or sits in the section Pseudo-coherent modules, I; the same-chapter items of the surrounding regions are the stably free and lifting statements (public 304-308, 335-341, 343-351, 353-356) and the later perfect-complex and derived-completion statements (public 404-413), all different propositions.

The whole-index search on the term pseudo-coherent returns four items, all from other chapters and none an equivalence for a complex over an arbitrary ring: public 254 (duality.tex, Tor-independent base change for the right adjoint of proper pushforward), public 383 and public 386 (perfect.tex, perfect complexes on affine opens and representability of relative Ext by pseudo-coherent complexes), and public 736 (spaces-pushouts.tex, gluing of pseudo-coherent derived triples). They use pseudo-coherence as a hypothesis or conclusion in geometric settings; none of them is lemma-cone-pseudo-coherent or lemma-finite-cohomology, the two same-chapter lemmas this proof consumes.

reference/retired-claims.json holds no record mentioning pseudo-coherent and no record from this chapter; PREPARATION_WORKLIST.jsonl contains no row whose claim_key, title or task path names this lemma (its only more-algebra.tex rows are the two sibling cards already published from the stably free section).
